title: DuckDuckGo
summary: Searches the web through DuckDuckGo's plain-HTML results page, read on the person's own device in their browser session, one search per request.
_note: Phase AV.19 (2026-11-12). html.duckduckgo.com's robots.txt allows all paths and its Terms carry no automated-query clause; its Acceptable Use Policy is for the owner to read before publishing. Result links point straight at the sites today; unwrapParam covers the older /l/?uddg= redirect. skipHosts drops DuckDuckGo's own links and ads. challengeText: the duck-picker page DuckDuckGo shows a request it takes for a bot (seen after ~150 searches in an hour from the iPad flywheel); the search then says so instead of 'nothing found'.
_recent: Phase AV.28: DuckDuckGo's own date filter (df=d past day, w week, m month), appended for a sentence with a time window.
